subject: BCP evidence consolidation for SIG submission and RTO/RPO workbook
messages:
From: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@acmecard.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: SOC2 Audit Team <soc2-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: consolidated BCP artifacts and RTO/RPO workbook for SIG

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week. AcmeCard's security team is preparing the SIG submission and the external auditor has asked us to consolidate Redwood's BCP/DR evidence in one packet. Specifically we need:

- RTO/RPO measurements and the logs backing those numbers (last 12 months).
- A short runbook summary that describes failover steps and responsible roles.
- Evidence that warm-cache / KV cache rehydration meets the stated RTO for our multi-region config.
- Any recent tabletop or failover test reports (dates, outcomes, participants).

Can you confirm what you can provide and share a single archive or Drive folder? Also please include contact for a 45-minute walkthrough the auditor can join next week (UTC-friendly window).

We are aiming to submit the packet to the SIG portal by 2026-08-12. If you already have a templated workbook, that would be very helpful.

Attachments: none on our side.

Best,
Clara Hughes
Senior Security Manager
AcmeCard
clara.hughes@acmecard.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@acmecard.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated BCP artifacts and RTO/RPO workbook for SIG

Hi Clara — thanks for the clear list. We can produce a consolidated packet and a short walkthrough. High-level plan: 

1) RTO/RPO workbook: we will pull measured restore times and RPO deltas for the last 12 months and provide the supporting traces. (Attachment: RTO_RPO_Workbook_Q2_2026.xlsx)
2) Runbook summary: condensed PDF with responsible roles and escalation matrix. (Attachment: BCP_Runbook_Summary.pdf)
3) Warm-cache evidence: we will include KV cache rehydration timing for our multi-region config and a sample restore trace. (Attachment: restore_trace_sample.log)
4) Tabletop/test reports: summary list + links to recordings where applicable.

Proposed dates for the walkthrough (45 min, we can host a call and share screens):
- Tue 2026-08-04, 16:00–16:45 UTC
- Wed 2026-08-05, 13:00–13:45 UTC

We'll assemble the Drive folder and share a link by EOD Monday (2026-08-02). Rachel and Ben are looping in to confirm the technical artifacts and any redaction needs for logs.

Preview: some of the restore traces include environment IDs and short-lived internal hostnames — we'll sanitize those before submitting. If the auditor needs unreduced logs under NDA we can escalate to legal.

I attached the initial workbook and the runbook summary to speed review. Let me know which walkthrough slot works and whether the auditor prefers a deeper look at KV cache vs full runbook.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
[Attachment: RTO_RPO_Workbook_Q2_2026.xlsx]
[Attachment: BCP_Runbook_Summary.pdf]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@acmecard.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated BCP artifacts and RTO/RPO workbook for SIG

Naomi / Ben — quick notes from the infra side: 

- RTO numbers are measured from failover-init to restored-accepting-traffic across our warm-standby pools; those metrics are in the workbook (tab: measurement_notes). We have three recent successful rehearsals: 2026-03-14, 2026-05-19, 2026-06-28.
- KV cache rehydration: the sample trace shows the cold-start vs warm-start delta; for multi-region config KV syncs occur on a background stream and warms in ~18–28s median for current workload. We will call out the median and 95th percentile in the summary (we do not ship raw KV contents).
- Logs: restore_trace_sample.log is sanitized; it contains timeline events (init, snapshot-apply, kv-rehydrate, service-checks). If the auditor needs IP-level traces we need an explicit justification (PII/ops sensitivity).

I uploaded the sanitized artifacts to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-id/BCP_Playbook (see folder: /acmecard_SIG_packet).

On the walkthrough agenda I propose: 1) brief architecture & roles (10m), 2) measurement methodology & demo of a trace (20m), 3) Q&A & next steps (15m).

-Rachel
Rachel Kim
Director, Product Security (part of infra security)
[rachel.kim@redwood.com]

On Sun, Aug 2, 2026 at 09:03 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Clara — thanks for the clear list. We can produce a consolidated packet and a short walkthrough. High-level plan: ...

From: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@acmecard.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, SOC2 Audit Team <soc2-audit@thirdpartyaudit.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated BCP artifacts and RTO/RPO workbook for SIG

Hi Naomi / Rachel / Ben — this is excellent, thank you.

We reviewed the Drive folder and the workbook. A couple quick clarifications before the walkthrough: 

- For the KV rehydration numbers: can you confirm whether those medians include the extra time for network routing when failing across regions (i.e., cross-region traffic)? If not, can you provide a worst-case number or a note on expected delta?
- In the workbook the measurement timestamps are in UTC — please confirm the timezone used for the three rehearsal dates so our auditors align the reports.

We can do the walkthrough on Wed 2026-08-05 13:00–13:45 UTC (that works for our auditor). Please send a calendar invite with a conferencing link and the internal presenters listed.

If everything looks good after the walkthrough we'll upload the consolidated packet to the SIG portal by 2026-08-12 as requested.

Thanks again — see you on Wednesday.

Clara
Senior Security Manager, AcmeCard
clara.hughes@acmecard.com
[Signed attachment: auditor_contact.vcf]
